content: electron-builder universal mac builds (arm64+x64) split the asar into app-x64.asar/app-arm64.asar with a routing index.js; native modules cannot be fat-merged and code that hardcodes .node paths breaks. Building arm64 on Apple Silicon / x64 on Intel (or CI matrix) is more reliable than cross-compiling; consider shipping separate per-arch mac targets instead of universal to reduce complexity for an unsigned indie release.
